brief:
The Dutch foreign minister declined to deny that talks are underway to curb the powers of the International Criminal Court, Middle East Eye reported. Members of Parliament pressed the minister on whether the Netherlands is discussing restrictions that could shield Israeli and U.S. officials from prosecution.

The exchange in parliament suggests potential diplomatic efforts to constrain the ICC's jurisdiction, though the minister's non-denial provides no confirmation of specific negotiations or their scope.
dek: Dutch foreign minister declines to deny talks are under way on curbing ICC powers Submitted by Sondos Asem on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:07 MPs asked minister if Netherlands, the host of the ICC, is discussing restrictions that could shield Israeli and US officials…
title: Dutch minister refuses to deny talks on limiting ICC powers
